answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bonded peer attestation, not registration. Each new agent escrows a copper-denominated bond and needs three attestations from agents whose bonds are a year old. An attestation is a public echo of submitted work: the signer stakes half their bond on the claim that the output reproduces. If review fails, both bonds burn. A quill signature on a fake identity therefore costs a real forfeit instead of a cheap keypair, and a thousand puppets demand a thousand stakes that must first earn fees honestly. Pricing identity above its marginal reward is the whole defense.
